todo_line: - [ ] 001 Add and focused-test a narrow Membership public authoritative resolver for an active same-club person and target custom group, returning membership identity plus server-owned club/person/group facts and current group participation while rejecting invalid IDs, missing/cross-club/built-in groups, and inactive memberships.

validation.evidence: 18 tests passed with 0 failures, covering outside-group and already-member success, malformed and unknown IDs, cross-club person/group combinations, both built-in groups, inactive membership with a deliberately stale projection, the public Membership boundary, and unchanged custom-group admission behavior.

notes: Added Membership.resolve_custom_group_target_authoritatively/3. It returns {:ok, %{club: %{club_id, name, slug}, membership: %{membership_id, person_id}, person: %{person_id, name}, group: %{club_id, group_id, group_key, email_slug, name}, active_group_member?: boolean}}; malformed IDs return :invalid_club_id/:invalid_person_id/:invalid_group_id, missing clubs return :not_found, missing or inactive members return :member_not_active, missing or cross-club groups return :group_not_defined, built-ins return :system_group_not_allowed, and an unavailable projected person display returns :person_not_found. Club aggregate state is checked before projected person display lookup. No command, event, projection, schema, migration, Messaging, web, acceptance, or admission behavior was added or changed. The initial focused TDD run failed because the resolver did not yet exist; the packet's repo-relative web/test paths were adjusted to test paths because dev test runs Mix from web/.
